title: Last Portrait of Turk
content: Turk, the gentle giant of a draft horse, died this week. I painted one last portrait of him and made a video tribute (Link to YouTube).He had been losing weight, even on a special rich diet, and one rear leg was so lame that he was almost unable to get up from the ground. He was around 28-30 years old.Portrait of the Belgian draft horse Turk, gouache, 5 x 8 inches.I stood by his stall and painted him in gouache. The challenge was that he didn't hold still, and even faced the wrong way most of the time.Paintings of TurkClockwise from upper left: Brush pen and watercolor pencils; Oil on panel; Watercolor and gouache; and Casein.
